titleEn: Into the Basket, Room on the Boat!

pages.text: "This shell shines most!" Bung lined shells along the floor, with wood pieces here and there. Ddori fiddled with a shell beside Bung.
"I will show the customer my shiniest shell!" Mom served noodles. The tied boat's floor grew more crowded.
Ddori pointed at an approaching customer boat. But there was nowhere to step. The customer paddled away.
Bung searched everywhere for the shiny shell, under wood and lifted bowls. Nothing. "Where is my shell?" Tears filled Bung's eyes.
Mom set down a big basket. "The floor is for customers to sit. There is no yard on water. Into the basket, room on the boat!" Bung looked at the crowded floor.
"Shells together, wood together?" Bung dropped a handful of shells inside. Rattle! "Into the basket, room on the boat!" came an excited call.
Shells rattled, wood thumped. As the basket filled, the floor cleared. Ddori added one small wood piece. "Ah!"
Bung drew Ddori's hand close and swept the last patch. Two customer boats pulled alongside together. Customers settled onto the clear floor.
At the basket bottom, the lost shell shone! "One, shells together! Two, wood together! Three, into the basket!" Bung held it out to show a customer.
Mom hugged Bung from behind and stroked the back. Tidying made room and brought lost things back. Bung patted the basket. "Into the basket, room on the boat!"
